title: Serpent and Meditation Mask
description: A vibrant purple and blue serpent with glowing green patterns coils around a wooden shelf filled with potion jars and scrolls. To the right, a golden demonic mask with horns hangs above an ornate oval portal showing a meditating figure floating above a cosmic green pool surrounded by glowing orbs.
prompt: A mystical scene featuring a large iridescent purple snake with glowing green patterns and red maple leaves coiled around a wooden apothecary shelf filled with potion bottles and scrolls. A golden horned demon mask with a somber expression hangs on a white banner beside an ornate oval portal with red border that reveals a person meditating in lotus position floating above a cosmic green vortex with glowing orbs, autumn leaves drifting through the air, rich fantasy illustration style
